mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating an accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, the average 5-day forward return is not negative (p>0.05 in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (both demand indicators) signals a broad-based weakening of consumer and business spending, which increases the likelihood of an economic slowdown and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% from prior month) does not produce negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases (win rate < 60%).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong supply expansion (indicated by industrial production above its 12-month moving average), a high level of industrial production signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the strong supply expansion regime (INDPRO > 12-month MA), the average 20-day forward return is not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of the consumer price index (CPI) signals persistent inflation, which increases the likelihood of central bank tightening and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1100.0, the average 20-day forward return is not negative (p>0.05) or the win rate is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a robust economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) does not produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases (win rate < 60%) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (as indicated by the business cycle phase), a strong quarterly GDP growth rate (above 2%) signals sustained economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when GDPC1 growth is above 2%, the average 5-day forward return is not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
